description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the co-occurrence number and accuracy percentage (ACC (%)) for various models, including Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different model: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), and MEMIT (purple, triangle marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 60% at a co-occurrence number of 3 and increases to approximately 67% at 3 x 10^3. The FT line begins at around 61% and rises to about 69% over the same range. The IKE line starts at roughly 65% and reaches around 71% at 3 x 10^3. The MEND line begins at approximately 66% and increases to about 75% at 3 x 10^3. The MEMIT line starts at around 66% and rises to approximately 74% over the same range. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend as the co-occurrence number increases.
